t: This is the memorial to William Vincent, who was Dean of Westminster from 1802 to 1815. He is both commemorated and depicted here, so the figure you're looking at is the dean himself. The memorial was made by Karen Newman, a British-born sculptor best known for her bronze bust of Violette Szabo on the Albert Embankment, outside Lambeth Palace. Vincent was also a scholar. Beyond that, I don't have further details, so look closely at the likeness and any inscription.
